doc_title: FORM OF CONSENT OF A CHARGEE TO A PARTITION
doc_title_official: FORM OF CONSENT OF A CHARGEE TO A PARTITION
when_used: A chargee consents to the partition of the charged land so that the partition can be registered on the title.

detail_rows.label: and if corporate the registered number, if any

body_text.text: The above named Chargee in respect of the Charge dated {{charge_date}} and registered as Entry Number {{charge_entry_number}} of the property comprised in the above noted Title HEREBY CONSENT for the land to be partitioned in the following manner;*
IN WITNESS WHEROF the Chargee has signed this Consent as a deed.

custom_fields.name: charge_date
custom_fields.label: Date of the Charge
custom_fields.prompt: The date the charge the chargee holds was made, for example 1st March 2020

custom_fields.name: charge_entry_number
custom_fields.label: Entry number of the Charge
custom_fields.prompt: The entry number under which the charge is registered in the encumbrances section of the register

custom_fields.name: partition_schedule
custom_fields.label: Manner of the partition
custom_fields.prompt: How the land is to be partitioned. One row per line, cells separated by a pipe: cadastral plan | title number | area (approximately) | proprietor number
